senses.gloss: बिल्वकादि a class of words headed by the word बिल्वक the affix ईय ( छ ) placed after which is elided when another tad. affix such as अण् or the like is placed after them; cf. बिल्वा यस्यां सन्ति बिल्वकी तस्यां भवा: बैल्वकाः Kas. on P.VI.4.153.
बिल्वादि a class of words headed by the word बिल्व, to which the tad. affix अ (अण् ) is added sense of 'a product' or 'a part'; e.g. बैल्व: मौद्गः, वैणव: etc.; cf Kas on P. IV. 3.136.
